description: Extension of OnboardingView handling permission monitoring, discovery, CLI installation, and local gateway probing.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: A view related to onboarding process, extended with functions for permissions, discovery, CLI, and gateway probe management.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Refreshes permission status by calling permissionMonitor.refreshNow asynchronously.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests a specific capability asynchronously, preventing duplicate requests and refreshing permissions afterward.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on page index.

methods.name: updateDiscoveryMonitoring
methods.description: Manages discovery monitoring state depending on the current page index, with a delayed start for discovery.

methods.name: updateMonitoring
methods.description: Updates both permission and discovery monitoring and triggers chat onboarding if needed.

methods.name: stopDiscovery
methods.description: Stops gateway discovery if it is active.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Asynchronously installs CLI if not already installing, updating CLI status message.

methods.name: refreshCLIStatus
methods.description: Refreshes the CLI installation location and status flags.

methods.name: refreshLocalGatewayProbe
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the local gateway port and updates the localGatewayProbe state based on command analysis.
